n8d63867deb.headline: Shippers warned to stay away from Iranian waters - Latest News
n8d63867deb.summary: Western-backed maritime forces have advised ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz to keep as far from Iranian territorial waters as possible to avoid seizure. The advisory comes amid heightened Iran-U.S. tensions.
n8d63867deb.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne oil and LNG shipments from the Gulf, so disruptions there can quickly affect global energy prices and shipping costs.
n8d63867deb.why_moved: Warnings of possible ship seizures in a major oil transit corridor raise the risk of supply disruption and higher shipping insurance costs, which tends to lift crude prices.
